C-STABILIZE-SPLIT-GESTURES.ApprovalBasis: Delegated owner recovery implementation; full original approved requirements retained. Execute sequentially: reading, gestures, full dual-edit; literal scopes below supersede prose paths and include command sources.

T-311.Title: Divider double-click becomes the split toggle; swap relocates

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Plain dblclick on the divider flips tab.splitView off through the same path as view.split-view (content, dirty state and per-tab guarantees of C-29 corner-1 hold); Alt/Option+dblclick swaps sides and persists splitViewSwapped; Enter on the focused divider still swaps; arrow-key ratio stepping unchanged.

A hit strip (~8px) along the right border of the editing surface renders only while split is off and the container is at least 800px wide, shows an ew-resize cursor on hover, and turns split on for the current tab on double-click; it never steals text selection, plain clicks or vertical-scrollbar drags (layering verified against the surface's scrollbar), and it is hidden while Diff Mode is on.

tests/e2e/split-view.spec.ts: the double-click corner asserts toggle-off (with content/dirty guarantees) and swap via Enter and Alt+dblclick; new assertions cover the strip's presence gating, hover hint, non-interference with selection and scrollbar, and hidden-in-diff; every other C-29 corner stays green; M-011/V-M-011 routing deltas land in the same bundle; MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY updated in touched files.

Corner.Situation: Divider double-click on a tab with unsaved changes
Corner.Expected: split turns off; content preserved bit-identical; dirty state untouched; no autosave trigger
sides swap; splitViewSwapped persists across restart; plain dblclick never swaps

Corner.Situation: Divider focused via keyboard, Enter pressed
Corner.Expected: sides swap (unchanged from C-29); arrow keys still step the ratio by 5% with clamping

Corner.Situation: Double-click on the right-edge strip while split is off, container 1280px
Corner.Expected: split turns on for the current tab only; other tabs keep their own state; same state flip as the menu item

Corner.Situation: Text selection ending near the right edge of the surface (drag through the strip zone)
Corner.Expected: selection completes normally; the strip does not swallow pointer events needed for selection or clicks

Corner.Situation: Vertical scrollbar drag at the right edge
Corner.Expected: scrollbar drags work; the strip never overlays the scrollbar's interactive area
strip hidden; split hidden; no interaction between the affordance and the diff surface
strip inert or hidden; double-click does nothing; widening past 800px restores it
toggle-on lands cursor-centered per that change's anchoring; without it, today's scroll behavior (recorded honest dependency)

Corner.Situation: Menu View item, Cmd+\ and command palette after the new gestures
Corner.Expected: all three still toggle the same per-tab state; no double-flip when a gesture and a shortcut race (single state flip per user action)
